name: Sharp
shortDescription: High-performance Node.js image processing library for resizing, optimization, and format conversion.
useCases: Server-side image resizing, cropping, and format conversion
Automatic optimization to WebP/AVIF with quality/size trade-offs
Generating thumbnails and responsive image variants on upload or on-demand
description: A high-performance Node.js image processing library powered by libvips—faster and more memory-efficient than ImageMagick/GD for common operations.
We use Sharp to generate responsive variants, optimize to modern formats (WebP/AVIF), strip metadata, and enforce size constraints in upload pipelines and edge/serverless functions.
